method: Unchanged seven premixes and 28 separated MP3s. Native OfflineAudioContext at 48 kHz using production factory. Four fixed windows/song inherited from v427 (prior, active vocal/band ratio, loud drums, energy drop). Raw original aligned by 1105/44100 seconds, stereo RMS matched. These are signal proxies, not verified lyric/event labels. Added room is isolated by subtracting otherwise-identical zero-room output without RMS normalization. Original-based 5 ms envelope peaks compare attack -10..+20 ms and tail +50..250 ms. Full song uses faders80/master100/loudness-1/blend gate .45 and unchanged song trims, independently measured by FFmpeg EBU R128/true peak. No listening verdict is claimed.

selection.reason: Lower only common room gain to .65; preserve relative part sends, existing EQ, direct signal and recorded tails. Less envelope deviation than shaped room, with similar original-referenced tail/attack error. Zero-room is a diagnostic comparator, not adopted because user requests some common live space. All measured original-reference improvements are small, not a clarity or separation score.

limits: Reduces only artificially added reflections; it does not remove the original recording room, source distortion or separation bleed. This is a small refinement.
RMS-matched spectral/envelope comparisons do not prove perceived clarity, intelligibility, natural shared distance, instrument identity or real iPhone performance.
Original playback bytes/processor, synthesis and scores, legacy live/dense and saved user faders are unchanged. Original-tab/remix comparison still needs volume matching.
Full-mix REC includes the mix; four-stem pack retains legacy separate taps without shared room.
